captions: Hey everyone, in this one I record a game clip on Windows 11 with Flown 2.4.1.
Grab the installer from flown.app/download, or run winget install Flown.Flown.
Your settings live in %APPDATA%\Flown\settings.json, and logs in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Flown\logs.
Press Ctrl+Shift+R to start, Win+Alt+R also works.
I export at 1080p60, H.264, about 12.5 Mbps.
Questions go to support@flown.app or @flownapp on X.
